title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Crack
subtitle: 灾害防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 灾害防范（灾害防范·灾害与防范）
meta: 主题语境：灾害防范（灾害防范·灾害与防范）　|　核心词汇：earthquake　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 earthquake 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 my grandfather ① lived through an earthquake that no neighbour in the town would have described, and he said the living was the whole of the summer. The ② earthquake, meaning the event and not the shaking, ran fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; an earthquake, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ earthquake in that town had the same short crack at the end of it, and the ④ earthquake at the end, meaning the one they kept for the valley and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An earthquake, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my grandfather said the describing is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the earthquake was the whole of the story, meaning the shaking and not the event. The ⑥ earthquake, meaning the shaking and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody feels and nobody names; earthquake, he said, is either something you live through or the only word that means both an event and a shaking. He said the shaking is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ earthquake had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short crack. The ⑧ earthquake of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in July, was one town and fourteen summers of describing; earthquake, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ earthquake I remember is the one named in the record, which passed in 1997 and is still described as the quietest in the town. An ⑩ earthquake, my grandmother said in 1999, is the only one that improves by being described; every earthquake, she said, is a shaking that has agreed to look like an event. She said the shaking was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地震（指那个镇子上遭遇过的那一场）
B. n. 地震（指那场地震本身，与震动相对）
C. 固定搭配：live through an earthquake 熬过一场地震
D. n. 地震（指留给河谷的那一场）
E. n. 地震（抽象总称，指一个镇子的防震之事）
F. n. 地震（指志书上写到、被列名的那一场）
G. n. 震动；社会震荡（指故事里人人都感到却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 震动（抽象总称，指人人都感到却无人说出的那种震荡）

items.q: lived through an earthquake that no neighbour in the town would have described
The earthquake, meaning the event and not the shaking
the earthquake was the whole of the story
the earthquake had become a line in a record
The earthquake of the whole thing

answers.why: live through an earthquake 意为“熬过一场地震”，1976 年祖父熬过了一场镇子上没有一位邻居肯描述出来的地震。
earthquake 意为“地震”，指那场地震本身而不是震动，它经过了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
earthquake 意为“地震”，指那个镇子上的每一场地震，每一场到头都有同一道短短的裂缝。
earthquake 意为“地震”，指留给河谷的那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
earthquake 意为“震动、社会震荡”，指故事里人人都感到却无人说出的那样东西，叔叔说这场震荡就是那个故事的全部。
earthquake 意为“震动”，指人人都感到却无人说出的那种震荡而不是那场地震，是故事里人人都感到、却无人说出的东西。
earthquake 意为“地震”，指志书上写到、被列名的那一场，到 1985 年这场地震成了志书里的一行。
earthquake 意为“地震”，祖父七月写道，整件事的防震之事是一个镇子和十四个夏天的讲述。
earthquake 意为“地震”，我记得的是志书上列名的那一场，1997 年过去了，至今仍被说成镇子上最安静的一场。
earthquake 为抽象总称，祖母 1999 年说，一场地震是唯一会因为被好好讲述而变得更好的东西。
